explication: Roubao is an iPhone AI agent that observes and operates apps on the user's phone, with an older Android agent retained separately. The iPhone flow is user prompt → agent/model planning → phone-control actions → task continuation, questions, and report files. The README documents voice input, model selection, approvals, recovery, and sharing; sampled source confirms the agent, device, and model components, but not every iOS subsystem connection. Android implementation relationships are limited to the sampled source index and excerpts.
